notes.body: - **Fewer hitches from work the screen did on every redraw:** the resume slot is saved once the table is quiet (at most every two seconds, and when you leave) instead of after every redraw; finding a card's picture is looked up once a match instead of on every redraw; a button's hover highlight no longer piles up a new listener on every redraw.

- **Card faces are drawn faster.** The shadow under every orb, symbol, bullet and number on a card was drawn again for every card; now each is drawn once and its pixels reused - the same picture, pixel for pixel. A card face that took up to a dozen extra drawing passes takes none, and is finished in two frames instead of nine.

- **You hold the card itself when you drag it**: it leaves your hand, stays exactly where you picked it up, leans a little as you move it, and slides back into your hand if you let go where it cannot be played.
- **Drop a Worker on your Worker zone** to play it (it sits level with your hand, and a drop there was taken for putting the card back).
- **Fewer hitches**: when one action asked for the screen to be redrawn several times in the same frame, it was - up to six times. Now it is redrawn at most twice a frame.
- **A card on the Stack for one of its triggers** (a Manifest, an Onslaught...) shows its current picture, not an old one.

- **The match is smoother.** Every action redraws the screen, and each redraw took about 30 ms - most of it spent loading the saved picture of every card in your hand again, only to cover it at once with the card drawn live. A hand of six took 88 ms; it takes 5 now, and the whole redraw 11.
- **Drag and drop works for every card.** A Worker, an Item, a Terrain or a Spell with nothing to aim at let go over the board was taken for a click on that field and did nothing; now a card goes onto a field only where one is lit for it, and anything else is played as itself.
- **A frame rate counter**: F3, or "Show FPS" on the Graphics page, shows the frames per second and the longest frame of the last half second in the top-left corner, on every screen.

- **Drawing a card lifts it off your deck** and lands it in its own place in your hand - face down, turning over on the way where you can see that hand. The card in your hand appears as it lands.
- **Discarding a card flies it from your hand to your graveyard**, face up, for both players to see.
- **Fixed:** under Zishin's Fate Pond, the revealed top card of each deck now actually shows on the deck.

- **Arctic Dragon has Resistance 2**, as its card has always said (its data had 0).
- A card whose saved picture is missing is now drawn live everywhere it is shown - picking from a pile, a trigger popping up, a Summon's own Spell on the Stack, the card you drag - instead of showing its name on a blank card.

- **Every card is now drawn live**, the ones with hand-made faces too: their picture is cut from their own face and the card is drawn around it, so 348 more cards show their current text, cost and stats - in hand, on the Stack, in the large view, the Deck Builder and Draft. Only 2 of 1,985 cards still show a saved picture.

- **The Deck Builder and Draft show live card faces**, drawn by the game from each card's art and data - the same faces as in a match, so a changed card or new art shows there at once.
- **The whole card pool is drawn in the background while you are on the menus** (about two minutes the first time, then kept on disk), so the Deck Builder opens on finished faces. It waits while you play a match.
- **Turning a page in the Deck Builder is smooth**: it took about 130 ms - the pool was filtered and sorted twice on every page - and now takes about 20 ms. The pages either side are read ahead, so a flip shows its faces at once.
